newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Soros's Argentine firm buys $25 mln of land/cattle.
newsitem.headline: Soros's Argentine firm buys $25 mln of land/cattle.

text.p: Cresud, an Argentine agribusiness company controlled by financial guru George Soros, said it bought from slaughter firm Swift Armour land and 90,000 cattle for $25 million.
Cresud told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange Thursday it acquired more than 50,000 hectares of land in Santa Fe and Chaco provinces for $6.0 million and cattle for $19 million.
Soros, Argentina's largest landwoner, also controls local real estate firm IRSA.
IRSA has been on a property buying spree in Argentina and also has interests in Chile, Brazil and Venezuela.
